description: This file defines the AttendanceSummaryReportController class, which manages the attendance summary report view in the OrangeHRM system. It integrates with frontend components and retrieves company structure data for display.

classes.name: AttendanceSummaryReportController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for preparing data and view components for the attendance summary report page.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of CompanyStructureService used to fetch company structure data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the component for the attendance summary report, including fetching subunit data from the service and adding it as a property to the frontend component.
